title: Class-II sharp-cube source-square reduction
statement: For the hash-pinned A1 production coefficients and the A7-A11 strict sharp rectangular-cube filtration, the adapted source satisfies sum_j ||G_j^* B(P_<=j-1 phi) D P_<=j-1 phi||_2^2 <= C_src ||phi||_6^6, where C_src=(beta_op^2/c_sym) M_R^2 M_6^4 Q_6^2. The separated production-budget route is now exactly ruled out: M_6>=8, Q_6>=8 sqrt(3), and H_6=M_6^4 Q_6^2>=786432, while the source-only target is H_6<29.62571266025876. This does not refute the exact source because B(X) JX=0 and the coarse bound discarded the output shell and determinant resolvent.
scope: PROVED-ANALYTIC-REDUCTION-AND-SCALAR-BUDGET-NOGO@FIXED-FLOOR-SHARP-CUBE on L=16 for the A1 production coefficients, three complex components in the six-real convention, rho_regularizer=1e-12, a common real-even scalar regulator with supremum M_R, and the strict sharp rectangular-cube dyadic filtration. The original cutoff-uniform reduction remains valid. T-047 is closed negatively by the exact Riesz boundary-modulation lower bound and an independent finite rational countercertificate. The coefficient-aware, output-shell-localised exact-B source bound and the production sextic budget remain open.
falsifier: Failure of the Pauli identities, a>=0, c>=0, ac-b^2>0, B(X)JX=0, or 0<=B(psi)<=4(a+2b+c)|psi|^2 I_6 at the fixed floor; a wrong N_(j-1)+1 shell boundary, physical 2pi/L factor, covariance convention, derivative-direction factor, or M_R^2 regulator power; failure of the strict-dyadic qualitative multiplier theorem; failure of the exact boundary-modulation identity, the L6 Riesz norm 2, the finite rational countercertificate, M_6>=8, Q_6>=8sqrt(3), or H_6>=786432; treating the coefficient-blind no-go as a counterexample to the exact-B shell source; or any authority hash, PDF QA, non-importing, assertion-count, or cross-route failure falsifies the pinned package.
